routes._comment: Routes match in ORDER, first match wins. The vendored marked bundle is version-pinned and never changes in place, so it must be matched BEFORE the /walkthroughs/* catch-all below or it would lose its immutable caching.

Catch-all for the 32 generated walkthrough pages plus reader.js, search.js, manifest.mjs, and search-index.json. These are regenerated on every release, so returning readers must revalidate rather than serve a stale page.
